_permissions_comment: Read-only web access is pre-authorized so research does not stall on per-site prompts (which subagents often cannot answer, causing silent research gaps). Source QUALITY is governed by judgment per .agents/skills/trusted-sources/SKILL.md — official/manufacturer + well-established references only, cross-checked. This covers WebSearch + read-only WebFetch (GET) ONLY; anything that writes/logs-in/posts to an external service still requires confirmation. Owner-approved 2026-07-25.
_comment: Shared, committed. Impeccable per-edit design detector: runs after Edit/Write/MultiEdit on UI files and surfaces findings as advisory reminders (non-blocking). Uses the repo's committed skill via relative path so it is portable across machines. Scoped rules live in .impeccable/config.json. This is IN ADDITION to the required /impeccable critique PR gate (AGENTS.md). Machine-local overrides go in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json.
_plugins_comment: Shared, committed, so this enables the plugin for every clone and for the cloud runner, not just one machine. Owner-approved 2026-08-09. superpowers adds a skills library (brainstorming, systematic-debugging and similar) plus a SessionStart injection; it does NOT change any repo rule. AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md (the former .claude/rules/) still win over any skill, per the plugin's own precedence note. To turn it off on one machine only, set it false in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json.
